answer: Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 4 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the island check. Bindings are kept in wander, verified in jetty, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history as a result fails the binding, as a result it has to store and read state per alias. That is 1038 dollars of sunk cost for a share worth less than the deposit itself. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
